Health/RedisDistributedLockHealthCheck.c.reason: Health check with constructor ThrowIfNull guards. Integration tests exercise with real Redis via Testcontainers.

RedisDistributedLockProvider.cs.reason: Lock provider with constructor + method ThrowIfNull guards. Integration tests exercise TryAcquire/Release/IsLocked with real Redis via Testcontainers.

justifications.unit: Measured 100%: the unit tests mock IDatabase and drive acquire, retry on a FakeTimeProvider, zero wait, extend and the logged release failure; 95 leaves room only for a defensive line added later.
justifications.guard: Measured 14.8%: the guard tests assert the ArgumentNullException of the constructor and of each public method; every other line runs only past those guards and belongs to the unit flag.
justifications.integration: Measured 74%: the Testcontainers Redis tests run TryAcquire, IsLocked, Extend and release against a real server; AcquireAsync, provider-level ExtendAsync and the release-failure catch are left to the unit flag because a real server cannot be made to fail on demand.
